name: Broll
description: Still pictures cut as shots (a picture being moved, which reads as a warp when watched: not a film's motion): each shot is one plate with a clip baked from it (a parallax travel or a tween of key poses), panned and held in a slightly unsteady hand, with live steam, falling snow or dust and small things crossing. Give it the full canvas box and two to three seconds a shot; it cuts hard at each shot's `at` and never shows the plate's edge.

shots.description: the shots in time order; each runs until the next one's `at` (the last to the clip's end)

plate_asset.description: the shot's picture (an image asset; any aspect, it covers the frame)

film_asset.description: a video baked from the plate (same aspect), played from the shot's start; without it the plate stays still and only the camera moves

loop.description: play the clip round and round (a flame or a boil tweened a, b, c, a); otherwise its last frame holds

at.description: when the shot cuts in (a Time)

pan.description: the frame centre's x in plate px, first to last frame of the shot; past the edge it stops at the edge

tilt.description: the frame centre's y in plate px, first to last frame

zoom.description: zoom at the first and last frame; raised when the hand's wobble needs room

steam.description: live steam or smoke (never draw it into the plate)

p.description: where it rises from, in plate px

w.description: width of the source in plate px (a chimney mouth, a pot)

rise.description: how far it rises in plate px

color.description: a light colour for steam, a grey for smoke

blend.description: screen for steam, normal or multiply for smoke

air.description: falling snow or drifting dust, at two depths: small slow specks far, a few large soft ones near

n.description: far specks on a screenful of the plate at zoom 1

wind.description: drift in px a second, [x, y]; y over 0 falls

movers.description: small cut-outs crossing during the shot (a car, a bird)

asset.description: a cut-out image asset with alpha

line.description: its path in plate px, start to end, travelled over the whole shot

w.description: its width in plate px at the start of the line (what it would measure on the plate)

sizes.description: scale at the start and the end (smaller as it goes away)

hand.description: the hand-held wobble in px (0 = on a tripod)
